description: Recent Earthquakes is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia. The effects of an earthquake depend on many factors, such as the distance from the epicentre and the local ground conditions. Geoscience Australia provide data on recent earthquakes in australia, nearby regions and the work. Disclaimer Read about the limitations of this data. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia. Its tags are earthquakes, emergencymanagement, emergencymanagementnational, geosciences, geospatialinformation. It offers 1 resource(s) in kml. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
